text_block_list.text: Vrooooom...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Excellent. The bus is precisely on
schedule. Let's
get in.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: Are you happy with how summer camp went?

text_block_list.text:
Of course. How could I not be when I
made so
much progress in preparation
for the Japan Cup?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Let's go over the details of my progress
in the bus
and—
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Heeey! Wait for meee!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Falcon?! Why are you here?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
You should have been aboard the bus
that left
fifteen minutes ago. We even
went over your
itinerary last night.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Ehehe! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I see... So your impromptu concert for
the locals
went longer than expected,
which is why you're
tardy...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Falcon...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I-it was just supposed be a quick show! It
was only
gonna be one song to say
goodbye to everyone
we met here...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
But you should've heard the crowd!
...You must be
disappointed in me, huh?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Yes. I am.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Awww... ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
But I am only disappointed by the fact
that you
failed to notify anyone about
your show in
advance.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
You should have informed the
instructors and
staff about it the moment
you decided to hold
one since a delay
was inevitable.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
After all, your concerts are always so
popular.
One song alone would never
have sufficed.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Oh, Flash! ☆☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
The bus will depart momentarily. Please
do not
make a scene.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
You're sitting too close, Falcon. Please
shift five
centimeters to the right.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: I don't wanna! ☆ In fact, I'm gonna scooch five centimeters closer! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
And so, our lively summer camp comes
to a
close... And Эйсин Флэш doesn't
even insist on
going over our notes in
detail on the ride back.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
